2.  **Increasing Grid Gap** to `gap-8` (2rem / 32px) to ensure generous spacing between image cards.
3.  **Increasing Bottom Padding** to `pb-32` (8rem / 128px) on the grid container. This ensures that even if you scroll to the very bottom, the last row of images is lifted well above the prompt input bar and other potential UI elements, providing a clean visual clearance.

These changes will ensure the grid view layout is robust and spacious on all screen sizes.
